title: Reject inverted integer clamp bounds
prompt: Read README.md and AGENTS.md. Extend clamp(value: int, lower: int, upper: int) -> int in demo/numbers.py to raise ValueError when lower > upper. Preserve inclusive clamping for ordered or equal bounds and support negative integers. Inputs are integers; do not introduce other types, dependencies or extra validation. Add meaningful tests in tests/test_numbers.py and run the full suite. Do not edit the other task or shared files.
acceptance: Values below, within and above ordered bounds clamp correctly; equal and negative bounds work.
Meaningful regression tests and all project checks pass.
